blocks.text: Industrial chemistry (industry wali chemistry) mulk ki economy (maeeshat) aur rozmarra zindagi ke liye bohat ahem hai. Chapter ka yeh hissa manufacturing (cheezein banana) aur energy jaise sectors (shobon) mein is ki ahmiyat batata hai, aur ahem raw materials (kaccha maal) identify karta (pehchan karata) hai, khaas taur par woh jo Pakistan mein milte hain. Yeh polymerization jaise zaroori industrial processes aur petrochemicals, cosmetics aur cement jaisi industries mein un ke istemal batata hai. Aakhir mein chemical processes aur facilities (karkhanon) mein zaroori safety measures (hifazat ke qadam) par zor diya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Do industries batayein jin mein industrial chemistry istemal hoti hai.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: petrochemicals, cosmetics, cement, khuraak (food), fertilizers, kapra (textiles).

items: Industry: raw materials, industrial processes, un ke istemal aur safety measures.
